title: A completion of our earlier work on the Cauchy problem for non-effectively hyperbolic operators
summary: For hyperbolic differential operators $P$ with non-effectively hyperbolic double characteristics, we study the relationship between the Gevrey well-posedness threshold for strong well-posedness and the associated Hamilton map and flow. In our previous work, we showed that if the Hamilton map has a Jordan block of size $4$ on the double characteristic manifold $Σ$ of codimension $3$, then the Cauchy problem for $P$ is well-posed in the Gevrey class $1<s<3$ for all lower-order terms, and that this result is optimal.
